item.description: SAP SE (NYSE: SAP) today announced a series of AI innovations at its annual SAP TechEd conference that expands its portfolio for developers. The enhancements to the Joule Studio and Joule Work solutions and SAP Business AI Platform, including the latest tabular foundation model from SAP, offer new tools to build and extend AI agents, a richer data and business context for those agents to reason with, and strengthened governance controls to run them responsibly across the enterprise.

item.description: ATLANTA, October 26, 2026-- Elavon, a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank and a global payments leader, today announced plans to embed its payments capabilities into SAP’s Digital Payments Add-On and Open Payment Framework applications, helping enterprises reduce the complexity of managing payments across finance, commerce and other core business operations. Elavon also has joined the SAP PartnerEdge program to support the development and delivery of integrated products and services.
